description: This PHP class 'VariableCleanupRule' provides methods to parse and modify panel configurations for different views in the SuiteCRM system. It performs variable renaming and cleanup tasks specific to DetailView and EditView contexts, aiding in the transformation of legacy or custom data structures.

classes.name: VariableCleanupRule
classes.description: A utility class for refining panel configurations during metadata conversion in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Modifiers for panels based on view type ('DetailView' or 'EditView'), cleaning and transforming variable names according to specific rules, such as removing suffixes, resetting certain IDs, or converting multienum variables.
